correctness.rationale: The parity correspondence d_A(2t)=d_A(2t+c)=H(t) is a direct bijection. Pairwise coprimality makes nontrivial generating-function poles simple, proving H(t)=t²/(2abc)+(a+b+c)t/(2abc)+Q(t) with periodic Q; hence the exact shift identity and eventual strict monotonicity. The finite bound P makes T_p a ray and yields the translated <2,c> ideal and exact genus/Frobenius expressions. For (6,7,8), all 84 residue differences follow from a stated exact finite-sum formula and the shift identity, so the p≠1 conclusion is proved for all p. The saved standalone verifier tests 4317 finite identities and 101 p-levels but does not serve as the infinite argument.
